messages:
zoe_ap: Incoming invoice INV-3302 from Aurora Strat. Invoice references PO# A-559 but our system matches A-559 to a different vendor (Acct 00421). Routing flagged vendor mismatch and AP blocked.
rana_proc: Quick check: PO A-559 was issued for consultancy to vendor 'Aurora Strategy Ltd' (Acct 00999) last year. Could be a duplicate PO number across legal entities.
tom_sales: We asked vendor to use A-559-EMEA on recent work. Maybe they omitted suffix. I'll reach out to confirm.
vendor-bot: Aurora Strat (billing@aurorastrat.com) uploaded INV-3302 (PDF). Attachment: https://files.example.com/aurora/INV-3302.pdf
zoe_ap: Invoice total £6,250. Vendor listed company reg UK and VAT. AP needs vendor account to match before payment.
rana_proc: If vendor confirms that A-559 maps to their contract, procurement can create a PO alias and AP can apply alias match. That avoids reissue.
tom_sales: Vendor replied: "Confirm PO A-559 corresponds to Aurora Strat work (contract ref CS-21). No reissue needed. Use vendor account 00999."
finance-bot: Automation: created task T-9001 for procurement to add PO alias A-559->A-559-00999 and flag entity mapping.
zoe_ap: Added note on invoice: 'alias match applied per vendor confirmation 2025-09-02'. Re-running match...
finance-bot: Match succeeded. Invoice now linked to vendor Acct 00999 and PO A-559-00999. Routing to Finance-Approvals.
zoe_ap: Approver assigned, coding to GL 4305 (consulting). Scheduling for next Monday pay run. Closing thread.
